interpretation: Meaningful joint dependence improves hidden geometry over diagonal and scrambled dependence, but full covariance does not beat source-tuned interpolation on the fixed primary endpoint. The stronger superiority hypothesis is not supported. No tuning or replacement evaluation was performed after observing this result.
secondary_caution: At 250 and 500 ms the nonnegative source-fitted gains of both simple controls are zero. Apparent long-horizon gains do not establish superiority to a signed-gain temporal interpolation control.
independent_local_checks: Verified all six prediction-archive hashes, diagonal hidden-coordinate invariance, and all 120 means aggregated from 3360 trajectory-level rows. This is artifact verification, not independent rerunning of raw-data scoring.
